profile.headline: UX/UI Designer, Web Designer, Frontend Developer
profile.summary: UX/UI Designer with 4+ years of experience in responsive web design and development. Skilled in design systems, wireframing, and prototyping to craft user-centered experiences. Dedicated to solving design challenges through iteration and collaboration, with an interest in user research and usability testing.

positions.title: UX / UI Designer
positions.locationName: Canal Winchester, Ohio, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Developed style guides and website mockups through collaborative client engagements. 
- Created wireframes for content visualization before full design implementation. 
- Refined designs based on client feedback, ensuring alignment with project goals. 
- Trained new hires by providing hands-on guidance and step-by-step documentation. 
- Managed tasks and project data, adapting to evolving workflows to improve efficiency.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Designed responsive web mockups tailored to client goals, branding, and design best practices. 
- Presented designs to clients and iterated based on their feedback to enhance usability. 
- Developed and maintained web pages, ensuring seamless functionality and visual consistency. 
- Performed frontend updates and maintenance, optimizing performance and user experience. 
- Ensured brand consistency across projects by aligning visuals with company and client standards.
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), Interaction Design and +21 skills

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · Hybrid
positions.insights: Interaction Design, Adobe XD and +10 skills

positions.title: Design Intern
positions.description:
- Designed graphics and UI elements to enhance website aesthetics and user experience. 
- Designed and developed web pages, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines. 
- Collaborated with the marketing team and clients to create designs that met business goals.
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), Interaction Design and +13 skills
